question: What does David Ferrucci mean by an 'alien intelligence'?
title: IBM Watson, Jeopardy & Deep Conversations with AI
expected_points: An AI could develop its own internal framework independently of humans.
It could outperform humans at a task.
Its framework could still be difficult or impossible for humans to understand or explain.

question: What is Sebastian Thrun's view on whether we are living in a simulation?
title: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education
expected_points: He says we may or may not be living in a simulation.
He considers the question largely irrelevant to how humans should act.
He describes the universe as an information-processing system without implying that it has an intention.

question: What does Tomaso Poggio say about the possibility of time travel?
title: Brains, Minds, and Machines
expected_points: He says that in science one should be cautious about saying something is impossible.
He nevertheless considers time travel very unlikely to be possible.

question: Why does Richard Craib see the rise of collective power among ordinary people as both exciting and potentially dangerous?
title: WallStreetBets, Numerai, and the Future of Stock Trading
expected_points: Collective action can give ordinary people power against centralized or powerful institutions.
That empowerment can be exciting.
Large groups can also be manipulated by charismatic or influential leaders.

question: Why was Eugenia Kuyda skeptical of the idea that chatbots would become a universal interface for applications?
title: Friendship with an AI Companion
expected_points: Her team had already experimented with many chatbot use cases.
Those chatbot products had attracted very few users.
This made her doubt that people actually wanted chatbots as a universal interface.

question: Why does Ray Dalio say debt cycles become increasingly difficult for later generations to deal with?
title: Money, Power, and the Collapse of Empires
expected_points: Previous generations leave behind debt and financial conditions that constrain later generations.
Simply earning more or spending less may no longer be easy enough to solve the problem.
Governments may then monetize the debt, contributing to recurring cycles.

question: According to Daniel Negreanu, how realistic is the obvious Oreo tell in Rounders at high-level poker?
title: Poker
expected_points: An obvious tell like the Oreo behavior would be unlikely at the highest levels.
Elite players would exhibit subtler tells.
Examples include posture and timing.
